findings.what: The condition is inverted: it adds two spaces only to empty lines and leaves every non-empty continuation line at column 0, which is the opposite of what the doc comment says, so a forged `error[...]` line still starts a line of its own and blank lines pick up trailing whitespace (both new tests would fail).

findings.what: Only this test's message loses its hand-written two-space indent; any production message elsewhere that still writes `\n  ` itself will get four spaces once the emitter indents too, unless those call sites were changed in the same commit.
